2509.24766_fig_2.description: The implementation of Toffoli gate, preparation of Bell states and the four-qubit GHZ state. a, Quantum circuit diagram employed to estimate the population transfer fidelity of the four-qubit Toffoli gate. b, The measurement results of the four-qubit Toffoli gate truth table, which gives a population transfer fidelity of 95.9(0.03) % . c, Example circuit for establishing Bell entanglement between two nuclear spins. d, The state tomography of Bell state | Φ + ⟩ between N 2 and N 3 . e, Quantum circuit diagram for generating the four-qubit GHZ state.
